title: Incidence of Patients Waiting for Triaging at Hospital Emergency Departments and Public Education Efforts Launched
what_it_is: Incidence of Patients Waiting for Triaging at Hospital Emergency Departments and Public Education Efforts Launched

sections.label: Emergency department crowding measures
sections.summary: MOH uses ambulance diversions, GPFirst fee reductions, Urgent Care Centres and NurseFirst to manage emergency department demand.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Sometimes, a hospital emergency department may face a spike in urgent cases, for example, when the hospital is handling multiple patients from a major incident.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: In such a case, protocols for ambulance diversions to other hospitals will be activated.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: In such situations, other than ambulance diversions, the hospital will work with the ambulance crew to triage and activate additional hospital resources to unload the ambulances as expeditiously as possible.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Currently, 40% of emergency department attendances are not life-threatening nor urgent.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: To encourage these patients to seek care at the general practitioner (GP) clinics for non-urgent conditions, the Ministry of Health (MOH) introduced the GPFirst programme in 2014.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Under this programme, if the patient is first seen by a participating GP and is assessed to require further care at the Accident and Emergency (A&E) department, the hospital will reduce A&E fees by $50.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Currently, more than 1,000 GP clinics, including all Healthier SG clinics, participate in the GPFirst programme.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: MOH has also set up Urgent Care Centres for urgent but non-life-threatening medical conditions, and NurseFirst, a non-emergency helpline where residents can receive useful medical advice.
